name: Portainer Community Edition
free_limit: Free zlib-licensed self-hosted container management interface for Docker, Swarm, Podman and Kubernetes, including basic container deployment and management; no vendor software subscription for Community Edition.
watch_out: Portainer explicitly positions Community Edition for homelabs, personal projects and non-production environments, with no support, SLA or guaranteed security fixes. Business-critical production should use Business Edition. You supply and pay for infrastructure.
